baseline_models.focus_anchor: The parallel commands لِيُنفِقْ and فَلْيُنفِقْ are separately indexed to سَعَتِهِ and مِمَّا آتَاهُ, while قُدِرَ and لا يُكَلِّفُ set explicit limits.
baseline_models.mechanism: The duty to release resources remains constant while its quantity scales with actual capacity and received provision. Constriction changes the measure of outflow, not the existence of the outward obligation, and the giver is not asked to manufacture resources that have not arrived.

activation_trace.role: Money leaving in maintenance supplies the concrete outward transfer and makes both imperatives acts of resource release.
Material amplitude supplies the affluent case and sets its expenditure scale.
Reduction to a narrow measure supplies the constrained case without erasing its remaining measure.
An allotted grant makes provision a received share rather than self-generated wealth.
Giving and delivery define the available input from which both expenditure and obligation are measured.
The carrying of a difficult duty supplies the upper bound that received capacity prevents from becoming impossible.

changed_reading.before: A flat command to spend, followed by a general reassurance for poor people.
changed_reading.after: A graduated but nonzero maintenance rule: actual received means determine the size of outward transfer, and constriction recalibrates rather than cancels responsibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence قُدِرَ ... مَا آتَاهَا ... سَيَجْعَلُ ... بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا distinguishes a measured present, available affordance, future making, and later state.
baseline_models.mechanism: Present obligation is fitted to what has already become available, whereas ease belongs to a future act of transformation. The verse therefore sustains action inside hardship without pretending that hardship is already absent or that future resources may be spent in advance.

activation_trace.role: A bounded measure gives the present constrained state a definite, workable limit.
Readiness and an accessible approach make what has arrived the present affordance for action.
Making something become another state supplies the future conversion rather than mere discovery of ease.
Later succession keeps hardship and ease temporally distinct.
Concrete difficulty supplies the real present condition through which the command must operate.
Opening and facility after obstruction name the produced later condition.

changed_reading.before: The closing promise immediately neutralizes the preceding hardship.
changed_reading.after: The verse protects a temporal distinction: one acts from presently delivered affordances while hardship is real, and a different state is subsequently made.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ن ف ق command, the opposition of سعة and عسر, the limit on burdening a نفس, and the final يسر can be read as the vocabulary of opening a constricted system.
baseline_models.mechanism: Expenditure functions not only as loss but as an outlet through which pressure leaves a household system. Capacity is room, hardship is constriction or twisting, and calibrated outflow keeps a passage open until broader ease is made.

activation_trace.role: A penetrating tunnel with an outlet supplies the passage through which constrained resources can move.
Spatial amplitude turns capacity into room available within the system.
Venting distress supplies the pressure-release effect of proportionate support.
Twisting and obstruction make hardship a blocked configuration rather than only low income.
Opening after obstruction completes the pressure-to-passage mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Spending simply subtracts from one person's stock for another person's benefit.
changed_reading.after: Proportionate spending may be the outlet that prevents a constrained relational system from sealing shut and prepares room for later ease.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening legal sequence locates separation inside a counted, bounded residence and forbids premature expulsion; it then permits retention or separation at term and promises an exit. This turns the focus expenditure into maintenance of a protected transition corridor: support keeps persons housed and keeps a lawful future opening possible.

activation_trace.role: The outlet-passage image anchors support as what keeps a transition traversable.
Temporal succession anchors the focus promise in a process with a before and after.
Shelter and dwelling supply the protected interior that maintenance must preserve during transition.
A distinguishing barrier and endpoint give the transition enforceable edges rather than indefinite suspension.
Something coming to be after nonexistence supplies the possibility that the protected interval yields a genuinely new arrangement.
Passage to an exterior supplies the eventual opening toward which the maintained corridor leads.

structural_cues: 65:1 counts a waiting interval, forbids expulsion from dwellings, marks boundaries, and leaves room for a later new matter.
65:2 places retention or separation at the reached term and ends with an expressly made exit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded residence, a protected interval, possible novelty, and an exit; I infer that focus expenditure materially holds that corridor open. A live alternative is that these are adjacent legal rules without a corridor mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse sets an isolated amount of post-separation maintenance.
changed_reading.after: Maintenance is infrastructure for a bounded transition: it preserves shelter and agency long enough for a lawful new state or exit to become possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision can arrive from outside present calculation, yet every thing has a measure. The focus ceiling therefore follows realized provision rather than anxious forecasts: uncertainty concerns the source of later supply, not the precision of the present obligation.

activation_trace.role: An allotted grant anchors the currently received resource envelope.
The difficult duty remains bounded by that realized envelope.
Provision as an allotted gift supplies a later inflow whose source need not be predicted by the recipient.
Counting and calculation supply the forecast boundary that unexpected provision can cross.
A determinate measure prevents uncertainty of source from becoming indeterminacy of obligation.

structural_cues: 65:3 juxtaposes provision from where one does not calculate with sufficiency and a measure for every thing.
65:7 repeats received-gift language on both sides of the non-burden clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncalculated arrival and exact measure; I infer that present duty tracks received means while trust remains open to later inflow. A live alternative is that the uncalculated provision concerns deliverance generally, not budget formation.

changed_reading.before: Trust requires spending as though hoped-for resources are already present.
changed_reading.after: Trust opens the future source of provision without falsifying the present ledger: expenditure is exact to what has arrived, while later inflow remains genuinely unforecast.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence of an inwardly carried burden, a fixed term, laying the burden down in birth, and made ease gives the focus close a gestational temporality. Hardship can be a load whose proper resolution requires support through maturation rather than forced premature removal.

activation_trace.role: Carrying a difficult charge anchors the focus in the semantics of borne load.
The living self makes capacity embodied rather than merely numerical.
An inwardly carried pregnancy supplies a load that grows toward completion inside a body.
A fixed endpoint supplies the maturation horizon of the carried load.
Laying down pregnancy in birth supplies a concrete transition from burden to release.
Facility after obstruction names the ease made within the pregnancy-and-term sequence.

structural_cues: 65:4 orders pregnancy, appointed term, laying down the load, and made ease in one short sequence.
65:7 likewise orders bounded burden, present hardship, and subsequently made ease.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal gestation, term, delivery, and ease; I carry that temporal pattern into the focus burden clause. A live alternative confines the sequence to pregnancy law and leaves the focus promise non-gestational.

changed_reading.before: Ease is a quick replacement of an unpleasant financial state.
changed_reading.after: Ease can be a delivered state reached by carrying a bounded load to term; support protects maturation and release rather than demanding instant escape from hardship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of expenditure includes real disappearance from the spender's stock, but the preceding promise enlarges recompense. The local economy is therefore asymmetrical: measured outflow is genuine depletion at one level without exhausting the possible result at another.

activation_trace.role: Departure and exhaustion preserve the real material cost of spending.
Transformation anchors the possibility that the outcome is not identical to the outgoing amount.
Increase in greatness supplies an explicitly enlarged result.
Recompense for action provides the return channel whose scale may exceed the immediate outflow.

structural_cues: 65:5 ends by magnifying recompense immediately before 65:6-7 specify support and expenditure.
65:7 moves from resource departure to a future made state rather than promising that nothing leaves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies genuine depletion, enlarged recompense, and later transformation; I infer a non-zero-sum horizon around measured giving. A live alternative places recompense wholly beyond the material economy and leaves financial depletion unchanged.

changed_reading.before: Giving and future ease form a simple financial exchange in which the spent amount is promptly replaced.
changed_reading.after: The outflow remains costly, but its result need not be commensurate or immediate; enlargement belongs to a different return channel than simple reimbursement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direct lead-in defines means through housing, non-harm, non-constriction, pregnancy support, and payment for care. Capacity in the focus is therefore relational and ecological: it is the ability to maintain an inhabitable field for another person, not merely a private account balance.

activation_trace.role: Room opposed to narrowness anchors capacity as usable space as well as quantity.
A difficult right or charge anchors the rule against transferring an impossible load.
Dwelling and inhabitation supply the concrete field that means must sustain.
Available wealth and amplitude explicitly calibrate the housing field to actual means.
Reciprocal harming identifies a prohibited use of resource control against the dependent party.
Narrowing amplitude supplies the spatial-social failure that support must prevent.
Maintenance outflow directly connects the habitat obligations of 65:6 to the calibrated imperatives of the focus.

structural_cues: 65:6 says to house them from where and according to how the addressees dwell, then forbids harm designed to constrict them.
The same verse extends support through pregnancy and remunerates lactational care before 65:7 generalizes expenditure by capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dwelling, actual means, anti-harm, anti-constriction, and maintenance; I infer that capacity is measured by the livable relation it can sustain. A live alternative reduces سعة to disposable income alone.

changed_reading.before: Means-testing asks only how much money the payer owns.
changed_reading.after: Means-testing asks what level of shelter, bodily care, and non-coercive room the payer can actually keep available to the other party.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verses immediately after the focus show a community refusing ordered limits, undergoing exact account, and arriving at heavy consequence and loss. This makes the focus close one branch of a path rather than a mechanical timetable: responsive, measured circulation tends toward made ease, while arrogant refusal can terminate in depletion.

activation_trace.role: Opening after hardship anchors the ease branch of the sequence.
The commanded outward maintenance supplies the responsive action located before the bifurcation.
Arrogant departure from obedience supplies the contrasting refusal path.
Exact accounting makes consequences measured rather than accidental.
Injurious heaviness supplies the burden generated by the refusal path.
The terminal outcome of a process supplies the path's final state.
General diminution names the alternative terminus to ease.

structural_cues: 65:8-9 follow the focus promise with a settlement that defies command, is accounted severely, tastes its consequence, and ends in loss.
The focus itself places imperative action before the future making of ease.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command, refusal, account, and opposed outcomes; I infer a path-dependent contrast between responsive circulation and sealing refusal. A live alternative treats 65:8 as a wholly separate historical warning that does not qualify 65:7's promise.

changed_reading.before: After every hardship, ease arrives automatically regardless of response.
changed_reading.after: The close opens a live ease-path through measured response, while the following counter-sequence preserves a coexisting path in which refusal compounds burden into loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later reminder, recited signs, and movement from darkness to light activate a second kind of divine giving. The focus limit can include supplied intelligibility and orientation alongside material means: accountable demand follows some delivered capacity to see and act.

activation_trace.role: Giving and delivery keep مَا آتَاهَا open to an enabling gift while retaining its immediate material anchor.
Imposed difficult duty supplies the demand that must follow rather than precede enablement.
Mind and inward awareness make the receiving self capable of epistemic as well as material endowment.
A reminder that actively recalls supplies delivered orientation before accountable action.
A manifest sign supplies something made perceptible to the receiving self.
Illumination supplies the changed field of visibility in which action becomes possible.

structural_cues: 65:10-11 describe a reminder and recited clarifying signs whose function is movement from darkness into light.
65:7 predicates both expenditure and non-burden of what God has given.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivered reminder, signs, illumination, gift, and duty; I infer an enablement-before-demand principle that includes disclosure. A live alternative keeps مَا آتَاهَا strictly financial in this verse and treats revelation as a later parallel gift.

changed_reading.before: The non-burden clause concerns only the amount of money available.
changed_reading.after: Material means remain primary, but a coexisting reading treats supplied understanding and orientation as part of the capacity that must precede accountable demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus already permits a conduit reading through نفق, watercourse through إيتاء, and rain-provision through رزق. The later running rivers and widened channels turn that latent material analogy into a circulation model: received supply becomes life-giving when it continues through an outlet rather than being sealed as stock.

activation_trace.role: A tunnel with an outlet supplies the focus-side channel for outward movement.
A watercourse and the clearing of its route supply the incoming and directed channel.
Rain named as provision supplies the life-bearing material moving through the system.
Continuous running supplies movement rather than static possession.
Opening and widening until flow occurs supplies the conversion from constriction to ease.
The concluding allotted provision identifies the running scene as a completed provisioning field.

structural_cues: 65:11 places entry, gardens, running rivers, permanence, beneficence, and good provision in one result sequence.
65:7 repeats outward expenditure and ends by making openness after constriction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outlet, watercourse, rain-provision, running, and channel widening; I infer a cross-domain resource-circulation mechanism. A live alternative treats the river material as eschatological imagery with no economic feedback into 65:7.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a privately held stock from which a one-way subtraction is made.
changed_reading.after: Provision can be read as routed flow: reception creates an inlet, expenditure keeps an outlet open, and ease is the widened condition in which sustaining movement continues.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing cosmological frame joins measured creation, effective power, disclosed knowledge, and complete encompassing. It sharpens the focus non-burden clause from generic leniency into a claim of individualized fit: the assigner who gives and limits is represented as knowing the whole configuration in which each capacity sits.

activation_trace.role: A definite limit anchors the constrained person's individualized measure.
The difficult charge supplies what must be fitted to that known measure.
The delivered gift supplies the capacity against which the charge is bounded.
Measuring and proportioning creation supplies a scale-sensitive ordering rather than an undifferentiated command.
Effective power and command supply the agency able to assign and later transform states.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic frame in which capacities are not hidden from the assigner.
Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies whole-system awareness of each person's limits and relations.

structural_cues: 65:12 closes the unit with creation across levels, power over every thing, and knowledge encompassing every thing.
65:7 repeats God as giver, non-overburdener, and maker of the later state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, power, and encompassing knowledge; I infer that the focus limit claims precise fit to a fully known configuration. A live alternative reads 65:12 as doxological closure without specifying how individual obligations are calibrated.

changed_reading.before: The limit on burden is a broad consoling maxim with no account of its precision.
changed_reading.after: The limit is also an epistemic claim: obligation is fitted to a received capacity situated within a configuration represented as completely known.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س و ع mapping for the focus root و س ع, reading amplitude beside neglected dispersal. It remains anchored in the two سعة forms and the repeated outflow command, but downstream prose should present it only as a split-root shadow that disciplines abundance, never as the lexical replacement for سعة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَعَةٍ and سَعَتِهِ name the resource condition from which both the ordinary amplitude target and the packet's form-distant dissipation target branch.

activation_trace.role: Neglect that lets property wander away supplies a shadow in which abundance is unstable and can dissipate without accountable direction.
Directed expenditure converts possible dispersal into an accountable outward use.

changed_reading.before: Abundance is a stable reservoir, and expenditure is the only event that reduces it.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory shadow, abundance is already liable to undirected dispersal; the command gives its inevitable outward movement a responsible destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hypocrisy branch inside نفق and the performative overreach branch inside كلف within an expenditure command. It remains anchored in repeated يُنفِقْ, actual سعة, and the ban on burden beyond what was given; downstream prose should frame it as an audit of performative giving or concealed leakage, not an accusation that the commanded spender is a hypocrite.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verse repeats spending but repeatedly checks it against actual capacity, actual gift, and a prohibition on self-imposed excess.

activation_trace.role: A displayed entrance with a concealed exit supplies the possibility that visible generosity masks an undisclosed drain or evasion.
Affected overreach and self-display supply the performative pressure to give beyond truthful means.
Competition over a prized thing supplies the social comparison that can turn maintenance into display.

changed_reading.before: Any visibly large expenditure necessarily fulfills the command more fully.
changed_reading.after: A contained counter-reading tests whether visible outflow matches actual endowment and care, or hides leakage, rivalry, debt, or theatrical excess behind the appearance of generosity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the focus rain and incoming-flood branches with the non-dominant و س م target under the context root س م و, where first rain marks earth with growth. It remains anchored in focus provision, arrival, and outlet language and in 65:12's sky-earth pairing; downstream prose should call it a material analogy of uneven interlocal supply, not replace heavens with rain-marks or claim a literal water-cycle exegesis.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رِزْقُهُ, مِمَّا آتَاهُ, and repeated يُنفِقْ permit provision to be modeled as an arrival that must find an outlet across unequal local capacities.

activation_trace.role: Rain as provision supplies a life-bearing input distributed unevenly across ground.
A flood arriving from a rained-on land into an unrained land supplies transfer across local asymmetry.
A penetrating outlet supplies the route by which concentrated input reaches elsewhere.
First rain marking earth with vegetation supplies the visible activation of latent fertility by arriving provision.
Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive destination where transferred provision becomes growth.

changed_reading.before: Each household gives only from an isolated private stock.
changed_reading.after: As a cross-domain outlier, unequal endowment resembles rainfall across places: concentrated arrival creates an obligation to route life-bearing provision toward receptive but presently dry ground.

strongest_changes: The focus becomes a graduated but nonzero rule whose amount follows realized provision, not a flat demand or permission to spend anticipated resources.
The domestic context turns capacity into an inhabitable relation of shelter, bodily care, and non-constriction, while the gestational sequence gives ease a maturation-and-release temporality.
The post-focus warning preserves a path to loss alongside the path to ease, so the future opening is not flattened into an automatic timetable.
Conduit, river, rain, and channel branches sustain a coexisting hydraulic reading in which provision remains life-giving through routed circulation.
Reminder, signs, illumination, measured creation, and encompassing knowledge expand the non-burden clause into enablement-before-demand and exact individualized fit.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made the verse operate simultaneously as a maintenance rule, a protected transition corridor, an embodied load carried to term, a pressure-release and water-circulation system, and an epistemic claim about supplied capacity. The most unusual live activations came from non-dominant mappings: abundance shadowed by dissipation and heavens shadowed by first rain marking fertile ground.
remaining_uncertainties: The immediate material referent of مَا آتَاهَا remains stronger than the later epistemic-gift activation.
The gestational and hydraulic mechanisms may be contextual-material resonances rather than semantic extensions intended at every focus word.

The relation between commanded response and the promise of later ease remains open: the following loss sequence may qualify the path, or it may function as an adjacent warning without limiting the promise.
The split-root dissipation and rain-mark readings are packet-authorized but deliberately form-distant and should remain visibly exploratory.
